debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a f-a-k-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d s-e-t and l-e-f-t a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t t-r-a-i-l in the e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d s-p-o-o-f e-x-p-o-r-t a-n-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s and l-e-f-t c-o-p-i-e-s in the a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k
3) the actor m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-d p-e-r-m-i-t c-o-p-i-e-s and l-e-f-t r-e-p-r-o-d-u-c-t i-m-a-g-e-s in the f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-g-e-n-c-y d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e l-o-o-k-u-p
4) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d s-e-v-e-r-a-l o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s and l-e-f-t t-h-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g c-o-p-i-e-s as e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-i-c-e-a-n-d-p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
5) the actor s-e-a-l-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d and l-e-f-t the c-l-o-s-u-r-e n-o-t-e in the f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
